snippet.title: HIBERNATION by Insertrave - Full Play (NO Commentary) Looking for Small Town Killer (2024)
snippet.description:
HIBERNATION by Insertrave 
https://insertrave.itch.io/hibernation
https://insertrave.itch.io

A small but eerie town, an unknown killer, and a cash reward! In this short PSX style horror game, you play as a local detective investigating a murder in the hopes of earning themselves some cash for finding the killer. Venture into town, and see what you can find out for yourself!
